items.text: THE SOUL BECOMES DYED WITH THE COLOR OF ITS *THOUGHTS*.
items.author: MEDITATIONS 5.16

items.text: NEVER LET THE FUTURE DISTURB YOU. YOU WILL MEET IT WITH THE SAME WEAPONS OF *REASON* THAT ARM YOU TODAY.
items.author: MEDITATIONS 7.8

items.text: VERY LITTLE IS NEEDED TO MAKE A HAPPY LIFE. IT IS ALL WITHIN YOURSELF, IN YOUR WAY OF *THINKING*.
items.author: MEDITATIONS 7.67

cta.text: SAVE THIS FOR THE DAY YOU *NEED* IT.
